source_message.text:
[FREELANCER_NAME_001], a few points:
1\. I updated the content in the last file I sent you, but those changes were not reflected in book\_1.docx. I have made the edits again and am also sharing the updated doc file here. We can use this version.
2\. In the video you shared, most of the images appear to have curved lines on all 4 corners, which looks strange. Please check this.
3\. Can we italicize the text under "Mama's Hot Take"?
4\. The images in the Social Media chapter and What to Say Instead need updating because they are partially cut off. I’m sharing the pictures again.
5\. From the video, the pages seemed heavy to me, in the sense that some individual pages contained a lot of content. Could we add a little more spacing to the text, at least between paragraphs? It might make the pages feel a bit lighter.
